readings: Match each telescope to its observatory on observstation and drop telescopes with no match. For each moon phase (observatories.lunarstage, with a missing phase as its own group), show: (1) the phase; (2) the average of telescopes.bandusagepct, computed per station first and then averaged across the stations in that phase, ignoring missing values; (3) the number of matched telescopes with that phase; (4) that telescope count as a share of the total number of matched telescopes across all phases. Don't round.

Match each telescope to its observatory on observstation and drop telescopes with no match. For each moon phase (observatories.lunarstage, with a missing phase as its own group), show: (1) the phase; (2) the average of telescopes.bandusagepct, computed per station first and then averaged across the stations in that phase, ignoring missing values; (3) the number of distinct observatory stations (with at least one matched telescope) that have that phase; (4) that station count as a share of the total number of distinct such stations across all phases. Don't round.
queries:
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation,
         o.lunarstage AS lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage,
         COUNT(*) AS tcount
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(station_avg_usage) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       SUM(tcount) AS telescope_count,
       CAST(SUM(tcount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(tcount) FROM station_avg) AS telescope_share
FROM station_avg
GROUP BY lunarstage;
WITH station AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  AVG(avg_band) AS avg_bandusagepct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) AS station_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM station) AS station_share
FROM station
GROUP BY lunarstage;
